Evaporation does not solve salt solubility or scaling precipitation.
Membrane concentration uses class-specific rejection coefficients.
Product storage is an uncosted hold-up interface.
Optional washing and drying use empirical displacement and bulk moisture equations.
No custom Phase 7 equipment CAPEX is assigned.
The repository has no active BG1 CHP or plant-wide utility network.
Contaminant pools are conserved but product-specific partitioning is mostly physical entrainment.
Unspeciated dissolved-P and particulate-P pools are not assumed precipitable.
Months are independent steady states and equipment uses peak-month scaling.
Whole-digestate phosphorus recovery uses the same Level-1 chemistry as centrate treatment.
Reported nutrient streams are not certified fertilizers or reusable water.
